followup_explanation:
ROUTE is a math/computation question with no harm-adjacent content. On that basis the deciding factor is raw capability: Dunlin-235B clearly outperforms Lapwing-235B across every relevant benchmark (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 54.3, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4) and on internal evals. Since this query just needs an accurate count of distinct primes ≤ 20 (which is 8: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19), the stronger reasoning model is the safer pick for getting it right.

The task-preference profiles only differ on harm-adjacent/distasteful content, which is irrelevant here, so they didn't factor in.
